## How we collect and use your personal information

Personal information refers to any data that can be uniquely linked to a specific individual or can be used to identify that individual in some way. We adhere to the requirements of the Chinese Communications Security Bureau's Network Security Law and the Information Security Technology Personal Information Security Standard (GB/T 35273-2017) and other relevant laws. We prioritize the protection of your personal information based on legitimate, lawful, and necessary purposes.

## How we store and protect your personal information
